entities.name: Vladimír Zedník
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimír Zedník is a Czech former professional tennis player who represented Czechoslovakia. In 1975, he was a member of the Czechoslovak team which lost 3–2 in the final of the Davis Cup to the Swedish team led by Björn Borg. During his career Zedník won two singles and four doubles titles.
